hey can u help me understand this part of an nda i just got? it says: "The Receiving Party shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the Disclosing Party from and against any and all losses, damages, liabilities, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) arising out of or resulting from any breach of this Agreement or any unauthorized use of the Confidential Information by the Receiving Party or its Representatives." basically what does this mean for me if i mess up?

Sure thing! That clause is basically a **“big‑guy” liability promise**—if you (the Receiving Party) or anyone you let see the confidential info (your “Representatives”) breaches the NDA or uses the info without permission, you have to **pay** for everything that results. That includes the other side’s actual losses, any damages they suffer, and even the **reasonable attorneys’ fees** they incur while defending themselves. In short, if you slip up, you’ll be on the hook for the full financial fallout, not just a nominal fine. It’s a way of shifting the risk from the Disclosing Party onto you.
